title: Extremals and Thresholds for Critical Singular Anisotropic Moser-Trudinger Inequalities
summary: For $N\ge2$, $0 1$, we study maximizers of the critical singular anisotropic Moser--Trudinger integral \[ \int_{\mathbb{R}^N} \frac{Φ_{N,q,β} (λ_N(1-β/N)|u|^{N/(N-1)})} {F^o(x)^β}\,\mathrm{d}x, \qquad \|F(\nabla u)\|_N^a+\|u\|_q^b\le 1. \] where $a>0$, $0 0$ when $b 0$ if $1 1$, $q_-\le q N$ and attainment holds if and only if $0<a\le a_c$. An exact Euclidean reduction shows that the threshold is independent of the anisotropy. The proof combines critical--subcritical scaling with a nonlinear Green-function concentration bound.
